description: STM32 HardFault due to uninitialized function pointer
user_question: What caused this HardFault on STM32?
expected_root_cause: Uninitialized function pointer user_callback called in interrupt handler - points to 0x00000000
expected_fix: Initialize user_callback to a valid function or NULL and check before calling

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Initialize callback: callback_t user_callback = NULL; and check if (user_callback) user_callback();

expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Function pointer called at NULL address - uninitialized callback
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Initialize function pointers to NULL and check before calling
